title: Takar forecast scorecard
method: Contested markets only (crowd between 10% and 90%). Crowd probability on Manifold 7 days before resolution; outcome bought through Telegraph EVENT_OUTCOME_RESOLUTION_GENERAL and compared with the market's resolution; Brier score over confirmed outcomes only. Each confirmed outcome is also put to FACT_CHECK_GENERAL as a second, independent check, reported and not scored.
